analysis:
The only changed file in this batch is CHANGELOG.md, which is documentation. The diff renames the v0.10.9 candidate heading to v0.10.10 and adds release and upgrade notes for the new `darkbloom waitlist` command and approval gating for new sandbox and cluster setups. The v0.10.9 section below it is retitled as published and left otherwise untouched. There is no executable code, no key handling, no attestation or authorization path, and no wire or protocol change in what I was given, so the threat-model assets and trust boundaries are unaffected by this diff.

There are two unverified contracts. First, the notes state that when the coordinator offers no waitlists, new sandbox and cluster setups proceed as in 0.10.9. If the implementation does this by failing open on a coordinator error or on an unreachable coordinator, it could weaken the approval gate. The notes say unreachable or refused cases exit 1, and that only a coordinator without waitlists lets setup continue. The implementation is not in this batch, so I cannot confirm this.

Second, the waitlist and approval client code touches TB-013 (the sandbox installer and add-on) and the cluster setup path. A later pass should check that waitlist responses are not trusted for local privilege decisions, and that `darkbloom waitlist` sends nothing about the Mac. The notes claim it sends nothing about the Mac, but that is unverifiable here.

The notes also claim the registration payload, MLX pins and serving engine are unchanged from 0.10.9. That is an assertion in prose and not verified by this batch. I found no regression and no need to update the threat model from this documentation-only change.
